definitions.gloss: university of the arts; arts college
definitions.explanation: Short for {芸術大学|げいじゅつだいがく}: a university that teaches the arts, usually music as well as fine art and design. Said on its own, {芸大|げいだい} often means the Tokyo University of the Arts ({東京藝術大学|とうきょうげいじゅつだいがく}), the country's best-known one.

examples.japanese: {芸大|げいだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To sit the entrance exam for an arts university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸大|げいだい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: She studied piano at an arts university.

examples.japanese: {芸大|げいだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{倍率|ばいりつ}→倍率：15067_bairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{浪人|ろうにん}→浪人：13301_rounin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
examples.english: Arts university entrance exams are so competitive that it's not unusual for people to spend years retaking them.

notes:
Clipped from {芸術大学|げいじゅつだいがく}. Tokyo University of the Arts writes its name with the old form {藝|げい} ({東京藝術大学|とうきょうげいじゅつだいがく}), and students call it {藝大|げいだい} too.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸大生|げいだいせい}: a student at an arts university
- {芸大|げいだい}⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: a graduate of an arts university

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美大|びだい}→美大：33345_bidai⟧: an art college, for fine art and design; {芸大|げいだい} usually takes in music, and sometimes film and theatre, as well
